events.label: founding
events.text: Klemzig founded by German emigrants on land offered by George Fife Angas.

evidence.quote: In 1838 , Klemzig was founded by these emigrants

events.text: First Old Lutheran emigrants arrive at Port Misery, Oct 1838 to Jan 1839.

evidence.quote: The first groups of Old Lutheran emigrants arrived in Port Misery between October 1838 and January 1839

events.text: Klemzig renamed Gaza, commemorating the Third Battle of Gaza.
Klemzig reinstated as suburb name under the South Australia Nomenclature Act.

evidence.quote: Klemzig was re-instated as the suburb name with the enactment of the South Australia Nomenclature Act of 1935 on 12 December 1935

undated_mentions: Residents of Klemzig petitioned the South Australian Government during World War II to re-instate the name Gaza; requests denied.
